title: Concept: Refresh header targets a script scheme
description: The Refresh header points at a javascript: or vbscript: URL. Meta-refresh navigation is normally a redirect control, but a script scheme makes it execute code in the current origin, so a value that reaches this header from request data becomes a script-injection sink.
applicability: Responses that send a Refresh header.
risk: A redirect control is turned into script execution in the page origin; MEDIUM severity because impact depends on whether the target is attacker-influenced.
